decisions.reason: The high-resolution piezo printer is core hardware that fits the firm's established coding business, and performance meets aspirations at a growing firm, so there is no shortfall to trigger problemistic search.
The numbering module is a cheap software extension that supports the serialization strategy, so slack easily covers it even though its website visibility has faded.
The CodeScan app succeeds an earlier app and supports traceability at minimal cost, though as a free add-on it could be folded into other tools.
Inline code verification is central to the firm's push toward serialization and end-to-end traceability, so it meets strategic aspirations and warrants continued resources.
The layout design software was featured on the home page and serves as a common operating layer across the printer families, which fits the firm's digitalization direction.
